Here’s what you can do right now:

•    BOOK A TICKET
o    If you are booking in RSD (Serbian Dinars), you can already use our new simplified booking engine
o   You can also book a ticket in one of the 13 currencies available on our website, using the same booking engine
 
•         REGISTER AND MANAGE YOUR PROFILE
o   Register via Facebook, Google or e-mail verification
o   You can set the analytics and communications you want to receive

•         EASY FLIGHT CHECK-IN FROM YOUR MOBILE PHONE
o   Check in up to nine passengers in a few simple steps and avoid long waiting lines at the airport
 
•         PASSPORT SCANNING
o   Scan your passport or ID card using your phone camera and simply add documents for multiple passengers
o   You can save the documents at the time of check-in or at any other time on your profile and keep them for future check-ins
 
•         SAFE STORING OF TRAVEL DOCUMENTS
o   Save your and your travel companions’ travel documents to avoid having to repeat the process the next time you check in
 
•         KEEP YOUR BOARDING TICKETS HANDY
o   Show your boarding ticket even when you are offline

o   Download your boarding ticket in pdf format
